items.title: Hyderabad: Ex-security guard kills 5-year-old girl, demands ransom after hiding body
items.summary: A day after a five-year-old girl, Aurelia, was found dead in the cellar of her building in Kowkoor suburb of Hyderabad, a former security guard was arrested for her murder. Vikram Kumar, who had worked at the Villa Orchids gated community till recently, allegedly abducted Aurelia on October 10, killed her and hid her body before making ransom calls to her family. Malkajgiri Commissioner of Police told the media that Vikram killed the child by strangulation, tied stones to her body and left her in a water sump in the cellar of the building’s clubhouse, in an area without CCTV cameras. The Commissioner said that Vikram allegedly killed the child because he felt it would be difficult to take her along with him out of the gated community alive, and that it would make it easier to be traced. Aurelia lived at Villa Orchids with her parents, 13-year-old brother and grandparents. She would go to the clubhouse of the gated community by bicycle everyday to play, from around 6 pm to 7 pm, her father Milton Fernandes Moses said in a police complaint.
